title_en: PASSENGER — LAIKA, BELKA & STRELKA, HAM AND THE BIOLOGY FLIGHTS
title_ru: ПАССАЖИР — ЛАЙКА, БЕЛКА И СТРЕЛКА, ХЭМ И БИОЛОГИЧЕСКИЕ ПОЛЁТЫ
description: An interactive field guide to the animals that flew before people: V-2 fruit flies and the Albert monkeys, Dezik and Tsygan, Laika's overheating cabin on Sputnik 2, Belka and Strelka's first return from orbit, Ham's 14.6 g overshoot on Mercury-Redstone 2, Enos, Félicette, the Zond 5 tortoises and the Bion biosatellites — what each flight proved for Gagarin and Shepard, what it could not, and the animals who died.
og: Laika's cabin heat balance, Ham's ballistic arc (14.6 g instead of 11) and a matrix of what every biology flight answered for human spaceflight — checked against NASA SP-39 and the Mercury reports, with the deaths stated plainly.
